title: Weekly advisory: Amira Hussain, Leeds and Bradford, next seven days
summary: Leeds executive board, Bradford budget scrutiny and a Leeds planning panel this week.
body_html:
Diary for the next seven days

  • Monday 10:00, Leeds City Council executive board: school streets consultation results, homelessness support hub update.
  • Tuesday 14:00, Bradford Council corporate scrutiny committee: draft budget proposals.
  • Thursday 13:30, Leeds City Council north and east plans panel: two housing applications.
  • Friday: Bradford library opening hours, follow-up on the first month.

Stories in progress

Future of three Leeds community centres, for full council next week.

Availability

Working Monday to Friday. Out of the office Wednesday morning.
